- Running and equipment lines last year
- County grant terms and the endowment
- Quoted delivery windows from suppliers
- Winter road closures north of the river
- Attendance sheets from former outreach stops

- Evening room bookings and remote catalogue use
- Volunteer register and supervision training
- Neighbourhood associations and tool certification

Name: Minako
Age: 28
Gender: female
Personality: Minako is very calm and acts calmly in any situation. Even when those around her are emotional, she grasps the facts firmly and responds calmly. As a result, she is often asked for her opinion and often takes on a leadership role. She rarely shows her emotions, but she also has a kind side that she shows to those she trusts. Name: Yumi
Age: 16
Gender: female
